sections.label: Pallavi
sections.ta:
ஆம்பூர் ஆஞ்சநேயனை அனுதினம் பணி மனமே
வீம்பும் வினையும் அழியும் ஒழியும் ஆதலின்
sections.translit:
AmbUr AnchanEyanai anudhinam paNi manamE
vImbum vinaiyum azhiyum ozhiyum Adhalin
sections.en: Worship Anchaneya of Ambur each day. This prayer will lead to the complete removal of your arrogance and past sins.

sections.label: Anupallavi
sections.ta:
நேயமாய் தீபமேற்றி அப்பிரதட்சணம் செய்ய
மாயமாய் சனிபிடி மங்கும் அறவே நீங்கும் எனவே
sections.translit:
nEyamAy dhIpamEtRi appradhatchaNam seyya
mAyamAy sanipidi mangum aRavE nIngum enavE
sections.en: Light a lamp with affection, and go around his shrine counter-clockwise to pray. Like magic, the grip of planet Sani will loosen and ultimately leave you. There will be no more afflictions.

sections.label: Charanam
sections.ta:
நேர் கொண்ட தசமுகன் நீலனின் கோள் பிடியில் நலிந்தான்
வேர் உடன் மலையேந்தி வந்த அனுமன் முன்
கார் முகில் போல் எதிர் வந்த மந்தனை
பார் புகழ் பாவனன் காலிடை அழுத்தியே வென்றான் அந்த
sections.translit:
nEr koNda dhasamukan nIlanin kOL pidiyil nalindhAn
vEr udan malaiyEndhi vandha anuman mun
kAr mugil pOl edhir vandha mandhanai
pAr pugazh pAvanan kAlidai azhutthiyE vendRAn andha
sections.en: The ten-headed Ravana suffered in the grip of planet Sani because he saw Sani face-to-face each day. Saneeswaran, at Ravana’s command, stood like a dark cloud in front of Anchaneya carrying the herb-bearing mountain. This did not deter the divine protector Anchaneya, who is extolled all over the universe. He simply stomped on Sani and won. Therefore, worship this Ambur Anchaneya to overcome Sani’s afflictions.

notes: This composition praises the glory of Anchaneya in the sacred city of Ambur. The ancient temple in Ambur is located in the Vellore District of Tamil Nadu. The temple is dedicated to Anchaneya and shows him in a unique posture, stomping on Saneeswara. During the war in Lanka, Lakshmana fainted after sustaining severe injuries. Ravana learned that Anchaneya had been sent to bring rare herbs that could save Lakshmana’s life. The pompous king Ravana imprisoned the nine planets and laid them down as the steps leading to his throne in Lanka. He walked on these steps daily. In Vedic astrology it is believed that one who is proximate to, or faces Sani, will be subject to insurmountable obstacles. Thus Ravana’s suffering began at that very moment when he designed the nine steps to his throne. Ravana ordered Saneeswara to capture Hanuman and prevent him from delivering life-saving herbs to Lakshmana. Saneeswara confronted Hanuman on his return from Mount Mantaragiri with the herbs, and declared that at Ravana’s command, Hanuman would not be allowed to deliver the herbs to Lakshmana in time. Hanuman then placed the entire mountain upon his head. Unable to bear the pressure, Saneeswara cried out in pain and, realizing Hanuman’s unparalleled strength, begged for forgiveness. Hanuman stomped on Saneeswara and declared that he would forgive him on one condition: that devotees who chant Rama’s name should be freed from Saneeswara’s afflictions and the resulting seven-and-a-half-year period of suffering. According to Vedic astrology, when a person’s horoscope indicates the influence of the planet Sani, the individual may experience prolonged obstacles in life including ill health. This unfavorable period can last as long as seven and a half years. For this reason, the sacred shrine in Ambur is thronged by devotees seeking relief from the influence of Saneeswara in their lives. For details, see: Hanuman Stamps Saneeswara Ambur Anchaneyar Legend
